title: Itat e-dwar portal screenshot
subject: Polity
caption: Mockup of the Itat e‑dwar e‑filing portal for the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal
altText: A textbook‑style, high‑resolution illustration of the Itat e‑dwar e‑filing portal on a computer screen with a white background. The illustration shows the portal's header with the ITAT logo, a navigation bar with clearly labelled tabs (Home, File Return, Track Status, Help, Logout), a login panel with fields for User ID and Password and a Sign In button, and the main dashboard displaying labeled summary tiles for Pending Appeals, Submitted Documents, Notifications, and Recent Activity. Below the dashboard is a sample filing form with labeled fields for Appellant Name, PAN, Appeal Type dropdown, Upload Document selector, and a Submit Appeal button. The footer contains contact details and a disclaimer. All components are clearly labelled with arrows and text boxes, providing an accurate representation of the portal's user interface.
